Rumor: |"I heard you uncovered a lost shrine in Fungal Grotto. How eerie."
|"Did you hear some cultists found an old Daedric shrine in Fungal Grotto? Killed all the dreugh just to get at it."
|"I would have enjoyed tangling with the Orcs at Malak's Maw. They're strong fighters. Almost as strong as Nords."
|"Plague in Narsis? Hah! Those Dark Elves wouldn't know a real plague if it crawled out and bit them."
|"The moment the plague disappeared from the Gorge, traders were selling their wares again. Amazing."
|"Some of my Dark Elf friends are still upset that Saint Veloth's shrine was attacked. And by one of their own, no less."
|"Deepcrag kwama mine had some trouble recently. I always wondered why they call it a mine? They just harvest eggs."
|"The Dark Elves sure like their kwama eggs. I think they taste terrible, but that's just my opinion."
|"They say Argonians can smell skin-stealers. Must be why they went after the lizards first."
|"Heard you touched a glowing egg and then talked to a tree. Must've been strange."
|"Heard you found some witch raising Draugr in the Hall of the Dead. We live in dangerous times."
|"Old Hjurring's been spreading tales of how you defeated Malana. Very impressive!"
|"Is it true, Lodorr came back from the dead? And you killed him again? Fantastic!"
|"I was relieved to hear that Voljar's Meadery has reopened. Good mead warms the soul!"
|"Did you hear? They finally freed Fort Morvunskar from Fildgor Orcthane's troops."
|"I heard that the ghost of Queen Nurnhilde was seen in Fort Morvunskar."
|"Now Cradlecrush is crawling with giants? Is that better? Really?"
|"So Fildgor poisoned his own brother? And he expects the Nords to follow him? He's more foolish than I imagined."
|"You saved the King. You are a friend to all Nord people this day."
|"High-King Jorunn rules unopposed and Fildgor yet lives. The divines smile on the sons of Skyrim."
|"I heard someone gave Fildgor a warrior's death. Was that you?"
|"Word from Nimalten is that Aera Earth-Turner was a traitor? You were there. Is that true?"
|"Exile is better than a spy like Aera Earth-Turner deserved. You're more merciful than I would have been."
|"My brother was with you when you retook Fallowstone Hall."
|"Geirmund's Guardian. You have my respect."
|"You completed Geirmund's three challenges? Unbelievable."
|"I heard that you were there when the Reachmen released Sinmur's ghost."
|"You're the favored one, the one Ysgramor appeared to."
|"Did you really meet Ysgramor himself?"
|"The spirit of Shalidor returned and advising the Mages Guild! The times we live in."
